svg.title: EAP-SIM 完整认证流程时序图
svg.text: EAP-SIM Authentication Flow: Identity → Start → Challenge → Success (RFC 4186)
STA (SIM Card) → AP (Authenticator) → RADIUS Server → HLR/AuC PMK = MSK[0:32], Key derivation via SHA1 + FIPS 186-2 PRF
Total: 18 messages (EAPOL + RADIUS + HLR) · PMK derived from MSK[0:32] via GSM triplets · Ki never leaves the SIM card
Key chain: GSM Triplet → MK(SHA1) → K_encr|K_aut|MSK|EMSK(FIPS186-2-PRF) → PMK=MSK[0:32] → PTK(HMAC-SHA1, 4-way HS)
